rules.sentence: Fractures occur in only 8-15% of pediatric facial trauma cases that present to the ED.[26][27][28]

Soft tissue injuries to the face are common, with approximately 34 to 92% of facial trauma presentations in children having soft tissue injury, generally contusions or lacerations, and around 15 to 69% having a dental injury.[28][29][30][31]
